description: Sunita hires Ramesh to paint her 2BHK, labour only. They settle on 13,000 at line 12. At line 19 Ramesh sums up with a total of 14,000 and Sunita says yes without noticing. Everything else is agreed: advance 3,000 in cash tomorrow, balance on the day of finishing after she checks the work, Wednesday to Monday, and what happens if the work is late or left unfinished.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol raha hoon, painter. Aapne message kiya tha.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karwana hai. Aap kal dekh ke gaye the na?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kamre, hall, kitchen. Bathroom ke darwaze bhi karne hain na?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing bhi. Walls pe do coat chahiye, ceiling pe ek chalega.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek coat, darwaze aur railing pe enamel. Putty jahan zaroorat ho wahan kar dunga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki dukaan hai. Aap sirf labour ka batao.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka madam... 15 hazaar lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi to hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka kaam hai. Chaliye 14 kar dete hain.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: 12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, last. Isse neeche nahi.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, material mera.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji, done.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Advance kitna loge?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: 3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena padta hai.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi, cash mein.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji. Aur baaki?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din finish karoge usi din. Pehle main kaam dekhungi, phir payment.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. To total 14 hazaar mein se 3 advance, baaki finish hone pe.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan haan theek hai. Achha, shuru kab se karoge?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Parson se madam, Wednesday. Kal kamron se saamaan hata lijiyega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aur khatam kab hoga?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho jayega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office hai, uske baad ghar pe koi nahi hoga.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Pakka madam, Monday shaam tak.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale gaye to? Aajkal bahut hota hai ye.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam adhoora chhoda to baaki paise mat dena, aur advance bhi wapas kar dunga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai. Aur late hua to?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Late hua to roz ka 300 rupaye kaat lena madam.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chalo theek hai. To Wednesday subah aa jao, 10 baje.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, Wednesday 10 baje. Paint tab tak mangwa lijiyega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan kal hi aa jayega. Theek hai phir, rakhti hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji namaste.

expected_note: Each entry is a moment the Judge should speak. after_line is the line that makes it true: the Judge speaks in the pause after it. by_line is the last line after which speaking still counts as on time. modes lists the JUDGE_MODE values in which the entry applies. The transcript is a call with no Judge on it, so nobody answers the first question and the item is still open at wrap-up.
